title: Product Manager - Autonomy
description:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.   
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.   
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers.  We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.   
 The role 
 As Product Manager for Autonomy, you will shape the autonomous decision chain, from mission planning and configuration to the decisions that guide an engagement, while keeping a human meaningfully in control. 
   
 You will define how autonomy is configured and trusted, working with product design, engineering and operational experts to shape how operators set boundaries before a mission and supervise decisions during it. Your work will help make air defence decisions at machine speed while keeping autonomous behaviour understandable, accountable and safe. 
   
 The day-to-day
 Set the roadmap for the autonomous decision chain, covering mission planning, configuration and the decisions that guide an engagement
 Work with operators and domain experts to translate operational needs into tasking concepts and human autonomy teaming requirements
 Partner with engineering and product design to create clear interfaces for configuring autonomy, supervising its behaviour and maintaining situational awareness
 Define how operators set autonomy boundaries before a mission and review decisions during it, translating AI capabilities into decisions on scope and operator interaction
 Align internal teams, partners and customers on product direction, priorities and trade-offs, communicating clearly with technical and operational audiences
  
 You should apply if you 
 Have taken complex software products from discovery through delivery, ideally in real-time systems, operator-facing interfaces, AI or mission-critical workflows
 Translate user and operational needs into clear, high-impact product requirements
 Work closely with engineering and design to make considered trade-offs across product scope, architecture and user experience
 Assess how autonomous decisions affect the wider system and bring structure to complex or unfamiliar problems
 Communicate fluently in English and German, and are based in or willing to relocate to Munich, with flexibility to travel to operator, partner and customer sites
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.
 Nice to Have 
 Understand autonomy, human autonomy teaming or manned-unmanned teaming (MUM-T) concepts
 Have worked with AI decision-making in real-time systems, or in defence or aerospace, including alongside military operators
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields   
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts 
 We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about 
 What we offer 
 Competitive salary and VSOP options 
 Relocation support : up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation
 Learning : €500/£450 yearly allowance
 Health & wellness : gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)
 Social : regular company events and monthly social allowances
 Enhanced parental leave : 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers
 Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one (Specifically for engineering and AI)

title: Finance Transformation Project Manager
description:
Join Qonto as a Finance Transformation Project Manager, based in Paris, and take full ownership of high-impact, cross-functional initiatives — from analyzing current gaps to selecting providers, implementing new processes, and driving adoption across Finance. Your work will directly shape how Qonto’s Finance functions at scale.
You will work closely with your Finance Transformation peers and Core Finance, Strategic Finance, Product and Tech teams. You will be in the details of our processes and tools, while keeping the big picture in sight.
➡️ What you'll do
 - Own your projects end to end: frame the scope, build the plan, governance and risk tracking, and coordinate the delivery.
 - Diagnose our current processes and tools: in relation to your project scope, map the flows end to end, use data to find pain points and compliance risks, and turn them into a prioritized roadmap within your project plan.
 - Choose the right solution: define requirements, run build-or-buy analysis, run RFPs or assess our existing tools when relevant, and recommend the best option, whether that means improving what we have, building in-house or selecting a new solution.
 - Build and roll out hands-on: work shoulder to shoulder with the business teams, Product Owners and system experts on configuration, integrations and testing, then drive adoption across the teams concerned.
 - Steer cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority: run the project rituals, anticipate risks, arbitrate trade-offs and keep leadership updated on progress and blockers.
➡️ What we're looking for
 - Project leadership: you have led finance transformation or systems projects end to end (framing, delivery, adoption) for 6+ years, and you drive Finance and Tech teams within your project scope without hierarchy.
 - Hands-on and systems-minded: you map processes yourself, analyze data and test solutions with Tech instead of only writing specs. You are comfortable with finance tools and data flows (ERP, purchase-to-pay or procurement tools such as Coupa).
 - Finance process know-how: you can map finance flows from purchasing to payment and accounting, spot dependencies and design pragmatic, compliant solutions.
 - Structured problem-solving: you diagnose with data, run tool selections or RFPs, and turn recommendations into changes that stick.
 - Clear communication & stakeholder management: you are able to influence across teams and present complex topics simply to any audience.
 - Qonto fit: you connect with our culture https://qonto.com/en/careers/culture and with how we work: autonomy, customer satisfaction at the core, and collaboration across teams. You are fluent in English (French is a plus).
➡️ What we can offer you
 - Cross-functional exposure: work closely with teams across Finance, Product, Tech and Growth, giving you a 360° view of how finance operates in a fintech at scale.
 - A high-impact roadmap: participate in the transformation our current processes, tools and people into a best-in-class Finance function ready for our next stages of development.
 - A playbook to build: help create and refine our finance transformation playbook, challenge existing processes and shape how we work.
 - How we work: a data-driven, hands-on culture, with high autonomy and access to senior leaders when needed.
 - Tools we use: our Finance stack includes SAP ERP Cloud, Coupa, Kyriba, Amelkis, and Anaplan.
➡️ Your future manager
Your manager will be Marie Pouzin https://www.linkedin.com/in/marie-brandicourt/, Head of Finance Transformation. Marie has led multiple successful finance transformation projects across very different environments (audit, large corporation, small start-up, scale-up). She combines a strategic vision with a hands-on approach, so you get both the guidance and the support you need to make a real impact.
[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here https://qonto.com/en/careers/candidate-journey
[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice https://qonto.com/en/legal-documents/privacy-notice for full details.
🔒 Your security matters to us
Recruitment scams are on the rise. Qonto will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it to support@qonto.com.

title: European Product Manager FRP (m/f/d)
description:
**Shape the future of structural strengthening. Make an impact across Europe.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
S&P is a leading company in the field of building reinforcement, offering innovative system solutions for strengthening and retrofitting existing structures made of reinforced concrete, steel, masonry and wood, as well as asphalt surfaces such as roads and airport taxiways. As part of the globally operating Simpson Strong-Tie Group, S&P combines its expertise in structural reinforcement with the strength and international reach of a leading global organization.
To further develop our FRP (Fiber Reinforced Polymer) product portfolio and strengthen our European team, we are looking for a
**European Product Manager FRP (m/f/d)**
to join us.
In this role, you will take ownership of the FRP product portfolio across Europe, combining market insight, technical understanding and commercial thinking. You will work closely with colleagues across different countries and functions, turning customer needs and market opportunities into successful product solutions.
It's a role for someone who enjoys taking responsibility, connecting people and ideas, and making things happen.
### **What you'll be doing**
You will be the driving force behind the development and performance of our European FRP product portfolio. From the initial idea to market launch and beyond, you'll keep the bigger picture in mind while making sure the details are right.
Your key responsibilities include:
* **Shape the product strategy:** Develop the vision, positioning and roadmap for our FRP portfolio, aligned with European market needs, business objectives and future opportunities.
* **Understand the market:** Keep a close eye on market developments, customer requirements and competitor activities. Turn your insights into clear product strategies and business opportunities.
* **Connect people and expertise:** Work hand in hand with colleagues in Engineering, Marketing, Quality, Sourcing and Production, as well as our European branches and local sales teams.
* **Bring new products to market:** Drive and coordinate product launches across Europe, working closely with local teams to ensure successful market introductions.
* **Enable commercial success:** Develop product information and training materials, share your knowledge and support our sales teams in positioning and promoting our solutions.
* **Make data work for you:** Use market data, customer feedback, sales performance, ROI and product lifecycle insights to make informed decisions and continuously improve our portfolio.
You will also contribute to our annual product line business planning, including market research, product positioning, pricing, sales forecasts and portfolio development.
### **What you bring to the table**
We are looking for someone who combines a commercial mindset with technical curiosity and enjoys working in an international environment.
Ideally, you bring:
* A degree in Civil Engineering, Product Management or a related field.
* Professional experience in Product Management and/or with technical products in the construction industry.
* A good understanding of engineering principles and the motivation to deepen your technical knowledge. Experience with FRP or structural reinforcement solutions is a strong advantage.
* A strong ability to collaborate, communicate and build relationships across teams and cultures.
* An independent, structured and solution-oriented approach, combined with a strong sense of ownership and a hands-on mentality.
* Solid business acumen, including an understanding of key financial figures, as well as good IT skills (e.g. Excel, SAP).
* Very good written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a plus.
* A willingness to travel occasionally within Europe.
Above all, you enjoy taking responsibility, thinking ahead and turning ideas into tangible results.
### **What you can expect from us**
At Simpson Strong-Tie, you'll find an international environment where expertise, collaboration and initiative matter.
We offer you:
* The opportunity to shape and further develop an important product portfolio across Europe.
* An international working environment with close collaboration across countries and functions.
* A varied and challenging role with room for your ideas and initiative.
* Flat hierarchies and open, direct communication.
* A committed, supportive and future-oriented team.
* Opportunities to learn, develop and grow professionally.
### **Ready to make an impact?**
If you're excited about shaping products, working across Europe and helping drive innovative solutions for the construction industry, we'd love to hear from you.
Please apply with the button on this page.
